### Source Specification & Milestone Row (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`)
- **Milestone**: `P2 — MVP / Core Features`
- **Milestone file**: `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
- **Story**: `P2-L`
- **User story** (copy verbatim from `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`):
  `As a finance approver, I want configuration proposals for report definitions, recipe publishes, reference table changes, and schedule updates to submit PENDING_APPROVAL tickets via GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort and activate atomically via ConfigurationCutoverPort within the approval transaction at the validated Asia/Manila effective_at hour, so that configuration changes take effect safely only after maker-checker approval.`
- **Dependency**: `P2-E, P2-H, P2-K`
- **Surface**: `backend`
- **Size**: `7` (`AC-1` through `AC-7`)
- **Material**: `no`

### Relevant Accepted Lessons from `docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`
- `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` unless Maven Failsafe is explicitly wired in `pom.xml`.
- `L-003`: Define dedicated port value types (`ConfigurationTicketCreateCommand`, `SubmittedGovernanceTicketView` in `com.example.app.governance.port`; `ConfigurationCutoverRequest`, `ConfigurationCutoverResult` in `com.example.app.configuration.port`) on cross-context ports rather than returning internal domain entities.
- `L-004` / `L-005`: Annotate refusal-auditing service methods with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.
- `L-006`: PostgreSQL immutability trigger `trg_reference_table_rows_immutable` only allows inserting rows into `reference_table_rows` while the parent `reference_table_versions` record has `lifecycle_status = 'PENDING_PUBLISH'` (or `'DRAFT'`); transition `lifecycle_status` to `'ACTIVE'` during cutover.
- `L-008`: Expose a package-private accessor method (`other.jdbcTemplate()`) on `@Repository` classes when copying `JdbcTemplate` references.
- `L-010`: Normalize `": "` to `":"` in repository row mappers when reading PostgreSQL `JSONB` columns as strings.
- `L-011`: Call `TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` when `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` methods need to roll back staged DB writes before rethrowing `ContractProblemException`.

### Existing Codebase Context (for accurate AC and Preconditions)
- `com.example.app.governance.port.GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort` implemented by `GovernanceTicketSubmissionService` (`submitConfigurationTicket(ConfigurationTicketCreateCommand)` returning `SubmittedGovernanceTicketView`, allocating `TKT-CFG-<prefix>`, persisting `PENDING_APPROVAL` row in `governance_tickets` with `target_definition_id`, `target_recipe_version_id`, `target_reference_version_id`, `proposed_payload_json`, `effective_at`, `idempotency_key`, `version = 0`, and recording `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_CREATED` in `audit_log_entries`).
- `com.example.app.configuration.service.ConfigurationManagementService` and `ReferenceTableManagementService` submit `PENDING_APPROVAL` tickets via `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort.submitConfigurationTicket` when staging:
  - `POST /api/v1/definitions` (`REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, staged `is_active = false` until cutover)
  - `PUT /api/v1/definitions/{id}` (`REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`)
  - `POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/recipes` (`RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH`, staged `lifecycle_status = "PENDING_PUBLISH"`)
  - `POST /api/v1/reference-tables` (`REFERENCE_TABLE_CREATE`, initial version `v1` staged `lifecycle_status = "PENDING_PUBLISH"`)
  - `PUT /api/v1/reference-tables/{id}/rows` & `POST /api/v1/reference-tables/{id}/import` (`REFERENCE_TABLE_CHANGE`, new version staged `lifecycle_status = "PENDING_PUBLISH"`)
  - `PUT /api/v1/schedules/{id}` (`SCHEDULE_CHANGE`, validated `Asia/Manila` top-of-hour `effective_at` & `warningAcknowledged = true`)
- `com.example.app.governance.service.GovernanceTicketWorkflowService.approveTicket` (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve`) currently checks maker-checker separation (`requester_user_id != decided_by_user_id`) and invokes `enforceConfigurationExecutionFreeze` (`ExecutionFreezePort.hasInFlightRuns` after `configurationReadPort.lockDefinitionForUpdate`), and in `P2-L` must also validate the ticket's `Asia/Manila` top-of-hour `effective_at` precision (when `effective_at` is present on configuration tickets) and invoke `ConfigurationCutoverPort.applyCutover(ConfigurationCutoverRequest)` atomically inside the same PostgreSQL transaction before completing ticket approval (`status = "APPROVED"`, `version = version + 1`, `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED`), rolling back any partial state if cutover fails (`L-011`).
- On `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reject` or `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/cancel` for a configuration ticket, `ConfigurationCutoverPort` is NOT invoked: staged `PENDING_PUBLISH` recipe/reference-table versions remain unactivated (`PENDING_PUBLISH`), staged `REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE` definitions remain `is_active = false`, and existing `ACTIVE` recipes and reference table versions remain untouched for in-flight or future runs.

### Required Structure of `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-l-integration-governance-configuration-cutover.md`
Follow the exact structure and level of detail of `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-k-integration-governance-execution-freeze-archive.md`:
1. Header block:
   ```markdown
   # Feature: P2-L — Cross-Context Integration: Governance <-> Configuration Ticket Submission & Atomic Cutover

   Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features
   Milestone file: docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md
   Story: P2-L
   Surfaces: backend
   Material: no
   ```
2. `## User story` — exact 1-sentence user story from the milestone table.
3. `## Acceptance criteria` — exactly 7 Gherkin scenarios (`### AC-1` through `### AC-7`) matching `Size: 7`:
   - `AC-1` (`Kind: happy`): submit `PENDING_APPROVAL` configuration governance tickets via `GovernanceTicketSubmissionPort` across report definition, recipe version, reference table, and schedule staging endpoints (`POST /api/v1/definitions`, `PUT /api/v1/definitions/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/recipes`, `POST /api/v1/reference-tables`, `PUT /api/v1/reference-tables/{id}/rows`, `POST /api/v1/reference-tables/{id}/import`, `PUT /api/v1/schedules/{id}`) with `Asia/Manila` top-of-hour `effective_at`, target IDs, and `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_CREATED` audit trail.
   - `AC-2` (`Kind: happy`): atomically activate `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH` tickets via `ConfigurationCutoverPort.applyCutover` inside `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` after `ExecutionFreezePort` confirms zero in-flight runs (superseding prior `ACTIVE` recipe version to `SUPERSEDED` for 13-month retention, activating the `PENDING_PUBLISH` recipe version to `ACTIVE` with `approved_ticket_id`, updating `report_definitions.active_recipe_version_id` and `version`, transitioning the ticket to `APPROVED`, and recording `CONFIG_RECIPE_VERSION_ACTIVATED`, `CONFIG_CUTOVER_APPLIED`, and `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED` in `audit_log_entries`).
   - `AC-3` (`Kind: happy`): atomically activate `REFERENCE_TABLE_CREATE` and `REFERENCE_TABLE_CHANGE` tickets via `ConfigurationCutoverPort.applyCutover` inside `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` after `ExecutionFreezePort` confirms zero in-flight runs across referencing definitions (superseding the prior `ACTIVE` `reference_table_versions` row to `SUPERSEDED`, transitioning the target `PENDING_PUBLISH` version to `ACTIVE` with `approved_ticket_id`, updating `reference_tables.active_version_id` and `version`, transitioning the ticket to `APPROVED`, and recording `CONFIG_REFERENCE_TABLE_VERSION_ACTIVATED`, `CONFIG_CUTOVER_APPLIED`, and `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED`, so subsequent `ConfigurationReadPort` / `LOOKUP()` calls resolve the newly activated version).
   - `AC-4` (`Kind: happy`): atomically activate `REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`, and `SCHEDULE_CHANGE` tickets via `ConfigurationCutoverPort.applyCutover` inside `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/approve` at the validated `Asia/Manila` top-of-hour `effective_at` (activating staged report definitions with `is_active = true` or applying staged definition metadata/schedule updates and stamping `schedule_configs.last_approved_ticket_id` and `next_fire_at`, incrementing `version`, transitioning the ticket to `APPROVED`, and recording `CONFIG_CUTOVER_APPLIED` and `GOVERNANCE_TICKET_APPROVED`).
   - `AC-5` (`Kind: edge`): preserve active production configuration and roll back partial DB state when a configuration ticket is rejected or cancelled (`POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/reject`, `POST /api/v1/tickets/{id}/cancel`) or when `ConfigurationCutoverPort.applyCutover` encounters a concurrency/state failure mid-approval (`TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` per `L-011`, keeping the ticket in `PENDING_APPROVAL` and prior `ACTIVE` recipe/reference-table versions untouched).
   - `AC-6` (`Kind: negative`): refuse unauthenticated callers (`401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED`), unauthorized callers (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN`, `AUTHZ_DENIED`), maker-checker self-approvals (`403 SOD_MAKER_CHECKER_VIOLATION`, `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), BOLA unauthorized cancellations (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN`), and mutating requests under an active `View-As` overlay (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`, `VIEW_AS_MUTATION_BLOCKED`) across configuration staging and governance ticket decision endpoints without invoking `ConfigurationCutoverPort`.
   - `AC-7` (`Kind: negative`): refuse configuration ticket approvals when `ExecutionFreezePort` detects `JOB_QUEUED` or `RUNNING` runs (`409 EXECUTION_FREEZE_ACTIVE`, `EXECUTION_FREEZE_REFUSED`), when target definition/recipe/reference-table version resources are missing (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`) or not in `PENDING_PUBLISH` / activatable state (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`), when `effective_at` is not aligned to top-of-hour in `Asia/Manila` (`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`), or when `If-Match` / `version` is stale (`412 PRECONDITION_FAILED`) or the ticket is already terminal (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`).
4. `## Preconditions`, `## Desk check`, `## Out of scope`, `## NFRs`, `## Security-review triggers`, `## Regulations`, `## Open questions` (`none`), and `## Delivery approvals` (empty table header only, no approved rows yet).
